title: Eastside Boxing Club

services.name: Summer camp
services.desc: We're excited to launch our Summer Camp starting Monday, July 6th, running every Monday and Wednesday from 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM until the end of August. Designed to keep children active, engaged, and having fun while building/improving a new skill! our camp combines the discipline of boxing with a variety of mental and physical games. Participants will build confidence, coordination, teamwork, and fitness while enjoying a supportive environment with their peers. All sessions are led by qualified coaches, assisted by our junior members, and supported by the Vancouver Fire Rescue Services (VFRS). services.name: Beginner Boxing
services.desc: This class is designed for those ready to move beyond basics and explore light technical sparring-an essential step in your boxing journey. Mouth guards are advised for safety as you engage in drills focusing on accurate attacks & hand, trunk, and foot defenses. You'll gain valuable experience in contact work, preparing you for future sparring and competition. Join us to sharpen your technique, build your confidence, and get ready to enter the ring! Minimum 1 year of previous boxing experience is recommended. Please speak to us to talk about moving up. We like to start on time, so please arrive 15 minutes earlier before your class to give yourself enough time to check-in at the front desk

services.name: corporate classes
services.desc: Looking for a team building activity for your business? Our Corporate Boxing Classes offer the perfect blend of physical activity, team bonding, and fun. Our coaches will design a class for your experience level and goals. Class is an hour long, can be up to 30 people and we provide equipment. Most of our coaches offer both private group sessions and personal training sessions. Our gym has both boxing and weight lifting equipment, making for a great all round work out. Share your goals with us and we’ll partner you with a great coach to achieve them. Sarah has 8+ years experience competing across the UK, Europe and North America.
